subject: Launch sprint card + owner roster for ClearBay Health
messages:
From: Evan Li <evan.li@clearbay.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Clara Zhou <c.zhou@clearbay.com>, procurement@clearbay.com
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — proposal questions and initial timeline

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the proposal. We reviewed the SOW and we want to get the first 6-week rollout locked so our clinical ops teams can start training. High level asks:

- Can we get a week-by-week owner roster (who owns config, integrations, user acceptance, validation) rather than a single milestone list?
- We need clear acceptance criteria for week 3 (data ingestion) and week 6 (prod handover).
- Procurement flagged the need for a delivery calendar to sync with invoice milestones.

Can you send a single-page sprint card + MAP we can share with stakeholders? Preferably by end of day Monday.

Regards,
Evan Li
Director, Clinical Automation
ClearBay Health

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Evan Li <evan.li@clearbay.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — proposal questions and initial timeline

Evan — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a draft sprint card (ClearBay_MAP_sprint-card_v1.xlsx) and a short kickoff agenda. Quick summary of what you'll find:

- Week 0 (prep): account access + data schema signoff — owner: ClearBay (Clara) / Redwood PM (Soji).
- Week 1–2 (ingest & config): Redwood infra + ClearBay data team — owners: Monica (Redwood lead), Clara (ClearBay lead).
- Week 3 (validation): acceptance criteria listed (ingest coverage >= 95%, sample inference tests) — owners: Monica + ClearBay QA.
- Week 4–5 (integration + UAT): integration owners called out by system (EHR, analytics) — responsible: Karthik (infra), ClearBay Integrations.
- Week 6 (go-live & handover): production checklist and monitoring runbook — owners: Ben (CS) / ClearBay Ops.

Action items for now:
1) Clara, please confirm data-ownership names and a preferred cutover weekend window (we've suggested 8/29–8/30).
2) Procurement, please let us know invoice milestone cadence (we propose 30/40/30 tied to week 0/week 3/week 6).
3) Internal: Monica will add runbook owners and refine acceptance tests.

I want to be explicit about acceptance gating — if Week 3 validation fails we will execute the rollback + remediation lane documented in row 18 of the sprint card.

I'll update the MAP and re-send an email once we have confirmations.

Best,
Soji (Soojin) Lee
Engagement Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ClearBay_MAP_sprint-card_v1.xlsx; kickoff-agenda-ClearBay.docx

From: Clara Zhou <c.zhou@clearbay.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@clearbay.com>, procurement@clearbay.com
Date: 2026-08-10T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — proposal questions and initial timeline

Soji / team — thanks, this looks good and much clearer than the SOW table. A few clarifications from our side:

- Data owners: Amy Park (amy.park@clearbay.com) will be the primary data contact. She owns schema and CSV delivery.
- Cutover weekend: 8/29–8/30 works but we prefer a Friday-night start (8/28 10pm PT) with monitoring through Sunday.
- Week 3 acceptance: we need the sample inference tests to include 3 clinician workflows (triage, referral, discharge). Can you add that to the acceptance checklist?

Procurement: we'll accept the proposed 30/40/30 but need a soft copy of the delivery calendar to attach to our finance system.

Thanks — Clara
VP, Clinical Programs
ClearBay Health

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Clara Zhou <c.zhou@clearbay.com>, Evan Li <evan.li@clearbay.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — sprint card owners + technical details

Looping in the technical owners and adding a few specifics I updated in the attached sprint card (v1.1):

- Monica (Redwood PM): overall rollout coordination, acceptance checklist owner.
- Karthik (Infra): data ingestion pipeline, mapping, and endpoint readiness (ETA week 2 complete; buffer week 3).
- Ben (CS): monitoring runbook, on-call bridge for cutover and post-go-live (week 6).
- Dev notes: we will require a staging dataset (anonymized) by 8/14 to complete the pre-validation tests.

Acceptance checks added:
- Ingest completeness >= 95% across 3 sample clinics.
- Latency SLA: 99th percentile < 350ms for sample inference calls.
- Security: access logs enabled and a service account with limited scope.

I also added a procurement-friendly delivery calendar (single row per invoice) to the bottom of the sheet.

Next steps: Soji will upload v1.1 to the shared drive and send a final copy to procurement. Clara — please confirm Amy will deliver the staging dataset by 8/14.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: ClearBay_MAP_sprint-card_v1.1.xlsx

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: procurement@clearbay.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — procurement and legal note

Quick note to procurement/legal:

We plan to start staging validation as soon as we receive the CSVs. If there are any redlines on SOW deliverables tied to week 3 acceptance, flag them now so we can accommodate.

Procurement, will you accept the 30/40/30 schedule, or do you need net-30 on final?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Evan Li <evan.li@clearbay.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Clara Zhou <c.zhou@clearbay.com>, procurement@clearbay.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch sprint card + owner roster for ClearBay Health

Soji / team — all good here. Amy confirmed dataset delivery for 8/14; procurement says 30/40/30 acceptable and will route the PO once they have the delivery calendar spreadsheet.

Please:
- Upload the v1.1 sprint card to the shared drive and post the link here.
- Add the 3 clinician workflows to the Week 3 acceptance checklist.

If we can get the updated sheet by EOD tomorrow we’ll lock the kickoff for 8/17.

Appreciate it — Evan
